title: Erogenous Zones
summary: Erogenous zones are body areas that can feel sexually pleasurable when touched — commonly the neck, ears, lips, inner thighs, nipples and genitals.
key_points: What feels good differs from person to person and even day to day.
Asking or noticing your partner's reactions is more reliable than any list.
answer_guidance: Keep it educational and point to communication rather than giving a 'map' that applies to everyone.
